description: Build immersive, cinematic 2.5D interactive websites using scroll storytelling, parallax depth, text animations, and premium scroll effects — no WebGL required. Use for CINEMATIC web design: scroll storytelling, parallax depth, text animations, hero sections, sticky sections, section overlaps, floating products, clip-path reveals, text that flies in from sides, words that light up on scroll, curtain drops, iris opens, card stacks, bleed typography, and any site that should feel cinematic or premium. Trigger on phrases like "make it feel alive", "Apple-style animation", "sections that overlap", "product rises between sections", "immersive", "scrollytelling", or any scroll-driven visual effect. Use aggressively for cinematic scroll-driven work. Covers 45+ techniques across 8 categories. Always inspects, judges, and plans assets before coding. NOT for a plain landing page (use landing for single-file HTML, landing-page-generator for React/Tailwind).
